name: PARANOIA
source:
What's the weirdest dream you've ever had?

Dreams make no sense. You might be doing something ridiculous or even impossible, but you just accept it as your new reality... Until you wake up. And let's be honest, we often forget what we dream.

What would happen if you introduced dreams to a society full of non-dreamers? 
This story is about that. A game that explores the terms: Aphantasia, Phantasia and Hyperphantasia.

In this visual novel, you play as [s]the player[/s] Damian, someone who has the ability to "Dream". But poor Damian has something bigger to take care of: Finding someone that "did something" to him (You decide if said thing is good or bad).

Choices matter.

This is just the beginning of a surreal experience where you,  [s]the player[/s]  as Damian, have to solve every mystery alongside a friend group where everyone is hiding something.

[From [url=https://kemonohenry.itch.io/paranoia]itch.io[/url]]
